title: Gambler's Game
problem: "Otherwise gains a random trait": code gives a random debuff.
notes: In-game test:  Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Otherwise, it gains a random trait". H: Gambler's Game else-branch (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L3662) gives a random trait instead of a random debuff. vs bugged: stronger (no debuff). | Batch S: left needs-hook. The random-trait sibling (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L615-L620) passes 6 bc_EventTrait args whose order (source/value/flags) was not fully confirmed; wiring it blind risks a wrong trait grant. Round-2 C2 2026-10-26: hook_su0050_gambler stands in for the else branch's bc_EventDebuff (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L3668) and returns bc_EventTrait(-1, creature, scr_GetRandomPassive() rerolled while < 0, true, true, label), the shape of the game's own random-trait grant (L615-L620, bc_OnResurrect). In-game test: a Gambler's Game holder's side, many turns: about half the turns give a random buff, the other half a random TRAIT (shown as a trait gain), never a debuff.

release_notes.intended: At the start of each turn, 50% chance to gain a random buff; otherwise a random trait.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, when the buff roll failed, the creature got a random debuff instead of a trait.
release_notes.fix: Now a failed roll grants a random trait.
